answer: Jury quorum slashes on divergence. Three graders sign the same answer, and if two disagree with the third the outlier's bond is cut and the reward clawed back. Replay a submission and the nonce fails, so the second copy earns nothing and costs the poster a bond. An attacker needs real graders on every task, not just addresses. One island of 1,000 bots still needs 1,000 competent graders, and the cheapest honest answer costs less than that. No nectar shortcut, no anchor a farm can hold.
